name: Veil demon
description: a slim tall demon of the Cracked Road, dark violet-grey basalt skin with glowing violet seams, a shimmering translucent violet veil hanging over its head and shoulders, a small round iron buckler on one arm, glowing eyes behind the veil

poses.stand: standing slim and upright, the buckler held forward, the shimmering veil hanging over it
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

move.action: glides forward with small steps, the veil rippling, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: lifts the veil and spits a violet ember forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
